description:
README.md still advertises BYO servers, Cloud apps, Serverless and WordPress as product lines, with a status table, quick-start instructions and links to docs for all of them. None of that code exists.

docs/ holds 77 files for deleted products: 30 VM_SITE_*.md and 47 SERVER_*.md. Several surviving docs link into them.

Trim README to the Edge product and fix the quick start. Delete or archive the dead docs and repair the inbound links. Note that docs/edge-roadmap.md and docs/edge-roadmap-next.md are completed history (Waves A-E, closed 2026-07-09) and carry their own doc-drift warning — they should be marked as history, not deleted. Clear the root cruft while here: _probes_tmp.php and the stray database.sqlite that the README says is unused.
title: Purge dead docs and stale README product lines
